The default changed in Vitest 5. Earlier versions matched loosely, and Vitest 5 makes exact matching the default for browser locators.

- **Before:** The v4 docs say the `browser.locators.exact` option was added in 4.1.3, and its default was `false`, so `getByText` matched substrings. When set to true, locators will match text exactly by default, requiring a full, case-sensitive match.
- **The change:** The Vitest 5.0.0-beta.4 release notes list "browser: Enable `locators.exact` by default" under breaking changes, with a link to PR #10430.
- **Now:** The current docs list the default as `true`. Under that setting, `getByText('Hello, World')` matches only that exact, case-sensitive string, not "Hello, World!" or "Say Hello, World".

**Migration:** If existing tests rely on partial matches, you have two options. You can set `browser.locators.exact: false` in your config, or pass `{ exact: false }` on individual calls, since per-call options override the default. The docs also show `exact: true` as an explicit per-call option.

I found only the release notes and docs, not the full migration guide, so check the Vitest 5 migration notes for anything else in that release.

content.text:
You've most likely upgraded to Vitest 5. Vitest 5 turned on `browser.locators.exact` by default (a breaking change in 5.0.0-beta.4, PR #10430). With that on, `getByText('Save')` needs a full, case-sensitive match, so it no longer finds "Save changes". In Vitest 4, `browser.locators.exact` defaulted to `false` (the option was added in 4.1.3), which is why substring matches used to work.

You can fix it in either of two ways:
- For a single call, use `getByText('Save', { exact: false })`, or just match the full text with `getByText('Save changes')`.
- To bring back the old behaviour everywhere, set `browser: { locators: { exact: false } }` in your Vitest config.

Sources:
- [Vitest 5.0.0-beta.4 breaking changes](https://newreleases.io/project/npm/vitest/release/5.0.0-beta.4)
- [Vitest docs: browser.locators config](https://vitest.dev/config/browser/locators)
- [Vitest v4 docs: browser.locators config](https://v4.vitest.dev/config/browser/locators)
